Factors That Affect 1-800-GOT-JUNK? Garage Cleanout Pricing

The cost of a 1-800-GOT-JUNK? garage cleanout depends on several factors, including:

  • Volume of junk: The more junk you need to be removed, the higher the cost.
  • Weight of junk: Heavy items like appliances and furniture may incur additional fees.
  • Location: Prices may vary depending on your location and the distance to the junkyard.
  • Type of junk: Hazardous materials, electronics, and other specialized items may require additional handling fees.

Estimating 1-800-GOT-JUNK? Garage Cleanout Costs

While it's difficult to provide an exact estimate without a site visit, 1-800-GOT-JUNK? offers a pricing calculator on their website that can give you an idea of the costs involved. Additionally, here are some general estimates for a garage cleanout:

  • Small garage cleanouts (less than 100 sq. ft.): $100-$300
  • Medium garage cleanouts (100-200 sq. ft.): $200-$500
  • Large garage cleanouts (200-300 sq. ft.): $300-$700

  • Electronics recycling: 1-800-GOT-JUNK? can properly dispose of electronic waste, including computers, smartphones, and televisions.
